mapper.select: select id , name from product_category order by id

select product_category.id product_category_id , product_category.name product_category_name , product.id product_id , product.name product_name , product.price product_price , product.image_url product_image_url , product.delete_flag product_delete_flag from product_category left outer join product on product_category.id = product.product_category_id order by product_category_id, product_id

select product_category.id product_category_id , product_category.name product_category_name , product.id product_id , product.name product_name , product.price product_price , product.image_url product_image_url , product.delete_flag product_delete_flag from product_category left outer join product on product_category.id = product.product_category_id where product_category.id = #{id}
